completed_work.summary: P0 restored and expanded the existing bridge web frontend as the actual Gridline Interface with 5 product surfaces, fixture-backed data layer, typed intent stubs, transcript-grounded design doctrine, and a comprehensive visual state system.

details.work: Digested 10 transcripts from 44 available. Extracted 8 paraphrased principles with traceable video_id and digest_sha256. 3 principles applied in this slice (data-attribute-driven layout, central theme token authority, integer-multiplied spacing system). Artifact at docs/json/frontend/lane_p0_pixelgrid_design_doctrine.v1.json

Added surface navigation bar with 5 tabs (Connect, Repository Estate, Project Studio, Inference Studio, Publish Preview). Each tab switches between cockpit and surface views. Surfaces coexist with existing Operator/Review/System/Technical/Analytics cockpit modes.

Renders Carte Blanche connection state (connected/disconnected/refused/error), repository access (granted/refused with token presence), and publication approval (granted/deferred/refused with reasons). Shows explicit distinction between repository authority and publication approval.

Renders repository list with clone status, public/private readiness distinctions, and blocked/error states. Shows intake discovery/import/failure counts and sync status. Matches J0 DeveloperGitHubWorkspaceService projection shape.

Renders K0 operator session state (status, phase, tool summary with success/failure/refusal counts, proposal dispositions, pending decisions, blocked capabilities) and L0 project understanding (study status, facts with provenance, languages/frameworks, public-ready assets, withheld material, draft narratives awaiting approval, context packet readiness, portfolio eligibility, approval status).

Renders M0 inference runtime availability (available/offline), task suitability per capability (JSON_OBJECT_FORMATTING_ONLY admitted, unsuitable tasks refused), review-required drafts with byte counts and sha256s, and refusal explanations with codes. Generated text is never displayed as approved.

Renders J0 publication readiness (not_prepared/review_required/ready with blockers) and L0 public-safe project profile candidate sections with evidence-backed status tags (proven/claimed/planned/narrative). Withheld/internal-only sections are listed with reasons but never rendered as publishable. Private/internal-only material cannot leak. Pages action preparation status shown truthfully (0 prepared).

Implemented renderStatusChip (connected/disconnected/deferred/pending/refused/blocked) and renderEvidenceTag (proven/claimed/planned/narrative). All 5 surfaces use typed visual states. Blocked, refused, degraded, corrupt, unavailable, and review-required states are first-class.

Every surface container has a visible fixture-banner. Each fixture object carries _fixture_backed:true and _fixture_disclaimer. emitP0Intent logs fixture_backed:true. Fixture-backed views cannot be mistaken for live bridge-connected state.

emitP0Intent function sends typed intents through WebSocket/pywebview bridge. Never calls GitHub APIs, filesystem, AgentLoop, context assembly, local inference, or publication authority. All intents carry authority:'none_local' and fixture_backed:true.

falsifiers_attempted: Is the product still effectively duplicated in SwiftUI? — NO. P0 operates on the existing bridge web frontend. N0 SwiftUI is reference-only. 5 product surfaces were added to the web frontend, not SwiftUI.
Can frontend code call privileged/backend operations directly? — NO. emitP0Intent sends typed intents through bridge. Never calls authority APIs.
Can private content leak into public preview? — NO. Publish Preview only renders public_sections. Withheld sections are explicitly separated.
Can fixture state be mistaken for live bridge state? — NO. 6 fixture banners visible. _fixture_backed:true on all fixtures. emitP0Intent logs fixture status.
Can generated draft text be presented as approved? — NO. Inference Studio tags review-required drafts. Project Studio shows approval_status.
Did Pixelgrid doctrine become ungrounded visual imitation? — NO. 8 principles each carry video_id and digest_sha256 traceable to transcripts.
Did P0 collide with N1 or O0? — NO. Only frontend/desktop/ and docs/json/frontend/ modified. No native host, backend service, or configuration changes.
Are Gridline/project page/portfolio distinct? — YES. Gridline = cockpit. Project Page = Publish Preview. Portfolio = deferred/unavailable (truthfully not implemented).
Are blocked/refused/degraded/corrupt states first-class? — YES. Status chips, evidence tags, refusal lists, pending decisions all rendered.
claim_adversary_results.verdict: All 9 falsifiers failed. The released boundary survives adversarial review. No claim adjustment required.
